name: Google Calendar pull
description: Bidirectional Google Calendar sync through the connection broker: incremental pulls stage events, while explicit local edits queue version-checked write-back.
prompt: Every hour, pull my primary Google Calendar into the vault. Walk the whole calendar page by page on first runs, then follow the sync token incrementally. Stage inbound changes for review unless I set auto-publish; send explicit local edits back with provider-version conflict protection.

vault.why: Stages Google Calendar events into the vault's review band and tracks the incremental syncToken cursor on the pull.gcal connection.
